en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a black and white photo of a city square with prominent buildings. In the middle background is a large church with a tall clock tower and pointed spire, while to the right is a classic monumental building. The setting appears quite orderly with fenced gardens and pathways. The text on the image identifies the buildings as 'Kyrkan och Högre Allmänna Läroverket' (Church and Higher General Secondary School) and 'Sundsvall,' suggesting this is from the Swedish city of Sundsvall. The reverse side of the card has handwritten address information, a Swedish 5 öre stamp, and a postmark that reads 'Sundsvall.'
